sentences.en: The sky was cloudless and vibrant, the brightest of blues.
sentences.zh: 天空晴朗无云，湛蓝得令人振奋。

sentences.en: On a recent brisk weekday morning, the market was vibrant.
sentences.zh: 在一个最近的凉爽工作日早晨，市场活力四溢。

sentences.en: Sami was blessed with a vibrant and growing career.
sentences.zh: 萨米拥有一份充满生机且不断发展的职业生涯。

senses.zh: 振动的；颤动的；响亮的 - 充满生气的；精力充沛的；兴奋的 - (尤指颜色)鲜明的，醒目的
